title: 2027 Doraemon Film Heads to 19th Century London
content: A website opened on Friday to announce the 2027 Doraemon film, Eiga Doraemon : Nobita no Jōki Jikansha ( Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam Time Locomotive). The film will open in spring 2027. The film's story begins as Nobita and his friends time travel to 19th century Victorian London.

title: Manga Mavericks Licenses Our Insignificant Justice Manga, Launches Independent Manga Alliance Venture
content: Manga Mavericks Books announced during its panel at San Diego Comic-Con on Thursday that it has licensed Rin Kawano 's Our Insignificant Justice ( Toru ni Taranai Bokura no Seigi ) and will release it in print and digitally in March 2027.
